intent.description: What the agent is trying to accomplish, in natural language.

entities.description: Domain entities the task touches; resolved against the provider's ontology.

verbs.description: What the agent plans to do to the provider's knowledge — drives binding_constraints.

artifacts.description: Concrete artifacts in play (paths, service names, doc ids).

token_budget.description: Maximum rendered pack size in model tokens; provider degrades gracefully.

as_of.description: Evaluate knowledge as of this instant (RFC 3339).

workspace_id.description: Task workspace this pack belongs to (context ledger).
